_comment: Backrooms collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line (pre-evolutions, evolutions and branches), worked out from Cobblemon's species data. Never list single stages by hand. The 18 lines were picked with random.Random('kane-pixels-level-0').sample() from species whose model never changes with aspects. 'extra_links' joins species Cobblemon's evolution data does not link, as [a, b] pairs.
